svg.text: --dangerously-enable-internet-mode Enable internet access without sandboxing (macOS/Linux only)
--secure-internet-mode Enable secure internet access without user data (macOS/Linux only)
--doctor Run diagnostics and auto-fixes (migrated to agent-doctor)
--meta-agent-role Role for the agent (macOS and Linux only)
--startup-context-mode Activate these context modes on fresh session start, overriding the `[ru
les.startup_mode]` config and any last-used modes. Comma-separated list of mode names. Subagents ignore this f
lag; only the main agent's SessionStart applies it
--meta-force-enable-features Force-enable MetaCode feature names. Comma-separated or repeatable
